query: SELECT e.sender_user_id, count(*) AS "created!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS "sent!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'completed') AS "completed!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'declined') AS "declined!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'voided') AS "voided!", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 'expired') AS "expired!" FROM envelopes AS e WHERE e.account_id = $1 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM envelope_states AS s WHERE s.account_id = e.account_id AND s.envelope_id = e.id) AND e.created_at >= $2 AND e.created_at < $3 AND ($4::uuid IS NULL OR e.sender_user_id = $4) GROUP BY e.sender_user_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC, e.sender_user_id
